visualCharacteristics.structure: metadata rail (tag, type, date, share/print) + title + intro

contentPattern: 1 row: [tag link p, content type p, date p] | [h1 title, intro p]; share/print tools rendered by code; tag/type/date and intro optional
reuseGuidance: Use as the first block of article/perspective pages: page title and intro beside a narrow metadata rail. Not for generic two-column content (use columns).
